summary: Hold Gull Rock; act strictly on the defensive.
Do not fire unless fired upon.
Keep the truce in Gull Sound: no reinforcement of Gull Rock while it holds.
notes: An agreement with no issuing post. A newer order from the Admiralty supersedes it; an order from the War Ministry does not (0040).

summary: Carry stores to Gull Rock and land them if not opposed.
